# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Conduct a full site visit. (Ask someone knowledgeable to accompany you.)
3. Carry out temporary measures, such as installing signage, as soon as possible.
4. Seek the advice of the fire-safety expert.
5. Make sure that the office-holder is up-to-date on their fire-safety training.
6. Speak to someone with knowledge of the building.
7. Begin your recommendations with actions required during the building inspection (British Standard 7273-4:2020).
8. Describe the required remedial actions to reasonable detail.
9. Obtain a qualified-fire engineer’s opinion in the event of a disagreement with a fire-safety expert.
10. Ensure that the office-holder and other interested players comprehend the content of the letter.
11. Obtain issuance by the office-holder.
12. Submit to the local firefighter.
13. Compile a formal audit of
